payload.title: Router keeps each site's vector index current and can query it
payload.description:
- seed_router_config.py reads custom.knowledgeQuery.s3VectorIndexArn from each site's amplify_outputs.json into monitorStories.vectorIndexArn (never typed by hand).
- The router's daily pass runs index_reference_passages(action="sync") for References accepted since the last sync, plus concept_card sync, before suggestions and packs. Indexing stops being a manual CLI step.
- infra/monitoring/papyrus-monitoring.yaml: s3vectors:GetVectors/QueryVectors/PutVectors on the seven index ARNs, folded into RouterIdeaPolicy (no new policy; role at 18/20). Change set for Ryan.
- Without an ARN: packs run without vectors; suggestions off with a logged reason.
Tests: config seeding; policy test; a run without an ARN logs the reason.
Owner rules that apply: no fixed caps, day windows or magic thresholds (derive or learn them; bound only by time, cost, context size); decisions go to decision models (Jev / the site Cyclotron), the LLM (GPT-6 Luna) only writes; Gherkin specs (narrative, complete) for every behaviour change; say "idea(s)", never "draft"/"proposed story".
